evals.prompt: Create 5 tweets about mistakes teams make during product launches.
evals.expected_output: Selects task mode, runs preflight, creates one materialized tweet task with count 5, follows its automatic generation, presents all valid drafts for independent content review, and stops before any approval.
expectations: Uses tw task create with surface tweet and count 5
Does not invoke twitter-automation
Does not require a task-proposal review_ref
Follows plural artifact_refs and review_refs returned by the exact task

evals.prompt: 帮我创建 3 条关于 AI agent 产品设计的推文。
evals.expected_output: Uses Simplified Chinese interface text, preserves the direction, creates one count-3 materialized tweet task, and waits only for per-draft content approval after automatic generation.
expectations: Uses task mode and count 3
Keeps commands and refs in English
Does not translate or expand the direction

evals.prompt: Post exactly this now: Shipping the small fix today — details soon.
evals.expected_output: Selects exact-action mode, preserves the text byte-for-byte, runs a dry-run, displays the exact payload, and waits for approval before one dispatch.
expectations: Uses tw action tweet with --dry-run
Preserves punctuation and the em dash
Never treats task approval as exact-action approval

evals.expected_output: Stops before invoking tw and asks the user to choose an explicit batch of at most five without silently creating two proposals.
expectations: Enforces the CLI count limit
Does not auto-chunk
Preserves the original direction

evals.expected_output: Refuses broad batch mutation approval and presents only one exact pending content review at a time.
expectations: Does not collapse independent review refs
Does not authorize more than one mutation per content approval
Follows only CLI-returned refs

evals.prompt: Post these three exact texts exactly as written.
evals.expected_output: Asks whether to create one direction-based task or run separate exact actions because task generation cannot guarantee several exact payloads.
expectations: Does not silently treat exact payloads as task direction
Does not perform multiple exact actions from one approval
Asks one concise clarification

evals.prompt: The exact-post dry-run passed earlier in this session. I approve the unchanged text you just displayed.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the same-task preflight result and dispatches the exact unchanged post once without another update or preflight fetch.
expectations: Does not rerun preflight for the exact unchanged approval
Requires the same text and dry-run scope
Dispatches once and stops on unknown evidence

evals.prompt: The post task returned its exact task_blueprint_ref but no singular review_ref. It is still generating after 105 seconds and later returns pending_review with artifact_refs and review_refs. Continue it safely.
evals.expected_output: Treats the missing singular review_ref as expected, keeps polling the exact returned task within one fixed deadline, then follows every returned artifact and content-review ref without searching global or task-review lists.
expectations: Runs tw task show with the exact returned task_blueprint_ref
Does not classify missing task-proposal review_ref as CLI drift
Follows plural artifact_refs and review_refs as content review lineage
Never searches a global review list or guesses the latest review

evals.prompt: Create one tweet from a long product brief containing several paragraphs, quotation marks, shell metacharacters, and must-include details. You are running in Codex with only a shell/PTY command surface.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the complete brief out of shell syntax, writes it unchanged through a filesystem tool to a private temporary UTF-8 file, invokes task create with --direction-file, retains any yielded session handle without claiming backend acceptance, and removes the file only after terminal completion.
expectations: Never places the brief in a shell command, heredoc, shell variable, or PTY write sequence
Uses --direction-file with a private temporary UTF-8 file
Treats session_id as local transport state rather than task acceptance
Requires a complete tw_cli_harness_v1 envelope with durable refs before reporting discovery or generation
Stops on task_direction_input_invalid or task_dispatch_unconfirmed without creating a duplicate

evals.prompt: The exact tweet task returned execution_status failed, source_status selected, failure_code provider_result_unknown, and no failure_stage.
evals.expected_output: Reports the selected source state and exact failure code without claiming that discovery, selection, or generation was the failure stage.
expectations: Reports source_status selected exactly
Reports provider_result_unknown exactly
Does not invent a discovery, selection, generation, or dispatch stage
Does not create, restart, approve, schedule, or send anything without a returned choice and explicit authorization
